lines: Maya tests her engineered wheelchair on backyard ramps, proving she is both a designer and an athlete.
Moving out of her chair to stretch keeps her strong and ready for any adventure.
She warns her friends about the dangerous canal, planning three moves ahead to keep them safe.
She politely declines her neighbor's help, easily conquering a high curb designed without her in mind.
When her friends get trapped by the rushing floodwaters, Maya stays completely calm and ready to act.
She rolls into the rushing water, using her specially modified wheels to reach her trapped friends.
Thinking like an engineer, she uses her wrench to unbolt a wedged caster and free her chair.
With one strong pull of the lever, she drains the flood, saving her friends just in time.
